Carnage” (the fed's own forum as the board rendered it on 15 December 2005 (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/forum-icw-the-last-call-130.html)). The card's own thread carries the handler's own out-of-character claim of a record under this name — “I believe my final record was 10-1 (as Carnage) I was undefeated as Daniels and Homicide too” — posted by the same member who answered the card announcement two lines above it (/promotions/pwe-inc/archive/icw-tlc-dated-2005-10-02.html). It is a self-report about matches that were never captured, not a match record; no reign, match or further character is minted from it.

identity.note: Three unconnected Carnages sit in this board's own record — this one, the FoB Wrath and Heavyweight contender of 2004 (carnage-fob), and the “Artist Formerly Known as ‘Carnage’” the fed's own October 2005 recap identifies as Trey Deep. Filed distinct; recorded in data/review-queue.json. Also shares the name with carnage (IWF/GIWF).

caption: Billed against Tatewaki Kuno on the farewell show, one of two names on that card whose own thread the booker opened and nobody answered.
